verses.en: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.pt: Paulo, apóstolo (não da parte dos seres humanos, nem por meio de homem algum, mas sim por Jesus Cristo, e por Deus Pai, que o ressuscitou dos mortos),
verses.en_web: Paul, an apostle (not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle (not from men, and not through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who made him come back from the dead),

verses.en: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.pt: e todos os irmãos que estão comigo, para as igrejas da Galácia.
verses.en_web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
verses.en_bbe: And all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:

verses.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.pt: Graça seja convosco, e também a paz de Deus Pai, e do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.en: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.pt: que deu a si mesmo pelos nossos pecados, para nos tirar da presente era maligna, conforme a vontade do nosso Deus e Pai,
verses.en_web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
verses.en_bbe: Who gave himself for our sins, so that he might make us free from this present evil world, after the purpose of our God and Father:

verses.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: ao qual seja a glória para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.en_web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: To whom be the glory for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.pt: Admiro-me de que tão rapidamente desviastes daquele que vos chamou na graça de Cristo, em troca de outro evangelho.
verses.en_web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;
verses.en_bbe: I am surprised that you are being so quickly turned away from him whose word came to you in the grace of Christ, to good news of a different sort;

verses.en: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.pt: Não que haja outro evangelho,porém há alguns que vos inquietam, e querem perverter o Evangelho de Cristo.
verses.en_web: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Which is not another sort: only there are some who give you trouble, desiring to make changes in the good news of Christ.

verses.en: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.pt: Porém, ainda que nós mesmos, ou um anjo do céu vos anuncie outro evangelho além do que já vos anunciamos, maldito seja.
verses.en_web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
verses.en_bbe: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, were to be a preacher to you of good news other than that which we have given you, let there be a curse on him.

verses.en: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.pt: Como já havíamos dito, volto também agora a dizer: se alguém vos anunciar outro evangelho além do que já recebestes, maldito seja.
verses.en_web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
verses.en_bbe: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man is a preacher to you of any good news other than that which has been given to you, let there be a curse on him.

verses.en: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.pt: Pois agora estou buscando a aprovação das pessoas, ou a de Deus? Ou procuro agradar a pessoas? Pois, se ainda tentasse agradar a pessoas, eu não seria servo de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Am I now using arguments to men, or God? or is it my desire to give men pleasure? if I was still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

verses.en: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.pt: Mas faço-vos saber, irmãos, que o Evangelho anunciado por mim não se baseia em pessoas;
verses.en_web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
verses.en_bbe: Because I say to you, my brothers, that the good news of which I was the preacher is not man's.

verses.en: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: pois não o recebi, nem aprendi de ser humano algum, mas sim pela revelação de Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For I did not get it from man, and I was not given teaching in it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.pt: Pois já ouvistes da minha conduta no judaísmo, como em excesso eu perseguia e tentava destruir a Igreja de Deus;
verses.en_web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.
verses.en_bbe: For news has come to you of my way of life in the past in the Jews' religion, how I was cruel without measure to the church of God, and did great damage to it:

verses.en: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.pt: e como no judaísmo eu era mais avançado que muitos de minha idade em minha nação, e era extremamente zeloso das tradições de meus pais.
verses.en_web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.en_bbe: And I went farther in the Jews' religion than a number of my generation among my countrymen, having a more burning interest in the beliefs handed down from my fathers.

verses.en: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.pt: Mas quando Deus ( que me separou desde o ventre da minha mãe, e por sua graça me chamou ) se agradou
verses.en_web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,
verses.en_bbe: But when it was the good pleasure of God, by whom I was marked out even from my mother's body, through his grace,

verses.en: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.pt: de revelar o seu Filho em mim, para eu evangelizar os gentios, de imediato, não fui pedir conselho com pessoa alguma;
verses.en_web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
verses.en_bbe: To give the revelation of his Son in me, so that I might give the news of him to the Gentiles; then I did not take the opinion of flesh and blood,

verses.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.pt: nem subi a Jerusalém para os que já eram apóstolos antes de mim; em vez disso, parti para a Arábia, e voltei outra vez a Damasco.
verses.en_web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
verses.en_bbe: And I went not up to Jerusalem to those who were Apostles before me; but I went away into Arabia, and again I came back to Damascus.

verses.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.pt: Então, depois de três anos, subi a Jerusalém para visitar Pedro, e estive com ele por quinze dias.
verses.en_web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.en_bbe: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Cephas, and was there with him fifteen days.

verses.en: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
verses.pt: E vi nenhum outro dos apóstolos, a não ser Tiago, o irmão do Senhor.
verses.en_web: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.en_bbe: But of the other Apostles I saw only James, the Lord's brother.

verses.en: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.pt: Ora, das coisas que vos escrevo, eis que, diante de Deus, não estou mentindo.
verses.en_web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
verses.en_bbe: Now God is witness that the things which I am writing to you are true.

verses.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.pt: Depois fui para as regiões da Síria e da Cilícia.
verses.en_web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.en_bbe: Then I came to the parts of Syria and Cilicia.

verses.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
verses.pt: Eu, porém, não era conhecido de rosto pelas igrejas da Judeia que estão em Cristo;
verses.en_web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
verses.en_bbe: And the churches of Judaea which were in Christ still had no knowledge of my face or person:

verses.en: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.pt: mas somente haviam ouvido que “Aquele que antes nos perseguia agora anuncia a fé que antes tentava destruir”.
verses.en_web: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
verses.en_bbe: Only it came to their ears that he who at one time was cruel to us is now preaching the faith which before had been attacked by him;

verses.en: And they glorified God in me.
verses.pt: E glorificavam a Deus por causa de mim.
verses.en_web: And they glorified God in me.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave glory to God in me.
